description: Convert an amount from UF to Chilean pesos or back, using the UF value of a given date, and return the UF value, date and source. Use it for rents, insurance and contracts in UF; use latam_indexacion for UVA, UVR or UDI. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/uf via x402.
